attributes.board_name: Alaska Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Social-work-related CE: postgraduate social work courses; courses offered or certified by ASWB or NASW (incl. state chapters); CSWE-accredited programs; professional organization seminars; cross-disciplinary courses; board-preapproved other courses (max 15 h); first-time presentation (max 10 h) or publication (max 10 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 21 contact hours if licensed fewer than 12 months of the period, otherwise 45.
rules.audit_note: Sworn statement of hours with renewal; discretionary audit after each period, documents due within 30 days; keep records 3 years.

topics.who: All; first renewal all 6 h must cover Alaska Native issues, later at least 3 h
Clinical supervisors, for licensing periods beginning after June 30, 2026

rules.notes: At least 10 hours must be live, live online or synchronous; the rest may be correspondence, recorded or asynchronous. Max 12 hours per day. Renewal fees: clinical $325, master $275, baccalaureate $225. Current licenses expire Jun 30, 2028.
